metadata.name: Pentose phosphate pathway (KEGG map00030)
metadata.description: Oxidative and non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway with the routes KEGG map00030 draws around it: Entner–Doudoroff, periplasmic glucose oxidation and the 2-ketogluconate route (bacteria), the non- and semi-phosphorylative ED (archaea), ribose / PRPP / deoxyribose, the ribulose monophosphate (RuMP) shunt of methylotrophs, sedoheptulose kinase and phosphoketolase. Derived from KEGG; drawn by GEMs MAP.

scope.note: The oxidative and non-oxidative phases are conserved; ED, glucose oxidation, the archaeal routes, RuMP and phosphoketolase are organism-specific (optional). Compartments are chosen by the person mapping onto a GEM (cytosol, plastid…).

citations.text: Kanehisa M, Goto S. KEGG: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes. Nucleic Acids Res 28:27-30 (2000)

source.generation_method: KEGG flat files + KGML (structure only) → curated biological graph → identities reconciled with MetaNetX (backend client) and the BiGG tables → hand-designed layout
